def module_path_with_qualname(path: str) ->Tuple[str, str]:
    """Parse <module>:<qualname> into its constituent parts, requiring both."""
    parts = path.split(":", 1)
    if len(parts) != 2:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(
            f"{path} must be in the form <module>:<qualname>"
        )
    module, qualname = parts
    if os.sep in module:  # Smells like a path
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(
            f"{module} does not look like a valid Python import path"
        )
    return module, qualname
